name: BillCraft
purpose: BillCraft is a privacy-first business document studio for creating professional invoices, quotations, receipts, estimates, and proforma invoices, with built-in calculations and PDF export.
problem: Freelancers and small businesses need professional business documents without expensive tools or cloud-based document storage.
benefits: Business documents that look premium and stay consistent
GST, discounts, and totals calculated instantly — no manual math
Documents stay on your device: no account, no cloud storage
proposedFeatures: Professional Documents — Create invoices, quotations, receipts, estimates, and proforma invoices.
Smart GST & PDF Export — Calculate taxes, discounts, and totals and export documents.
Privacy-First Processing — Process documents locally in the browser where supported.
plannedCapabilities: Local-only document generation — no account, no cloud storage — with PDF export

name: Cartora
purpose: Cartora is a smart shopping assistant concept designed to help users organize shopping lists, compare product value, and manage grocery budgets.
problem: Shoppers need an easier way to organize purchases, compare unit prices, and control spending.
benefits: Clear basket totals and a budget guard before you reach the counter
Unit-price comparison that shows which pack actually costs less
No login and no cloud — your shopping data stays on your device
proposedFeatures: Smart Shopping Lists — Organize planned purchases.
Unit Price Comparison — Compare product value where supported.
Budget Guard — Track estimated shopping totals against a budget.
plannedCapabilities: Shopping lists with basket totals and budget guard
Unit price comparison and discount calculation

name: NutriLens
purpose: NutriLens is a privacy-first food intelligence product concept intended to help users understand packaged-food labels, ingredients, and nutrition information.
problem: Nutrition labels and ingredient lists can be difficult for everyday shoppers to interpret.
benefits: Understand packaged-food labels and ingredients more easily
More informed food choices with transparent label information
Privacy-first processing — no account, no cloud storage
intendedUsers: People who want to make informed food choices
proposedFeatures: Food Label Scanner — Planned photo-based label scanning and text extraction.
Nutrition Insights — Intended to explain nutrition facts and ingredients.
Privacy-First Processing — Prioritize local processing wherever technically supported.
plannedCapabilities: Food-package photo analysis for visible label information
Local-first workflow with no account or cloud storage
Transparent nutrition, ingredient, and allergen review
